goal_text: (Reused from research_synth_008) Explain the three main transmission channels of monetary policy and how each links central bank rate decisions to the real economy.
ground_truth: The three main transmission channels are: (1) the interest rate channel — central bank rate changes directly affect borrowing costs for households and firms, influencing investment and consumption; (2) the credit channel — changes in bank capital and firm balance sheet health affect the volume of bank lending; (3) the asset price/wealth channel — rate changes affect bond, equity, and real estate prices, altering household wealth and spending.
